responsibility: This implementation module provides the gm2 coroutine scheduler and semaphore executive. It owns the runtime data structures for process descriptors, semaphore records, ready/existing/wait queues, the current process, and the always-runnable idle task, and it drives context switching through SYSTEM.NEWPROCESS, TRANSFER, IOTRANSFER, ListenLoop, and interrupt protection helpers. Its procedures create suspended processes, move descriptors among priority run queues and semaphore queues, implement Wait/Signal and interrupt waits, initialize the bootstrap and idle processes, and provide debugging/status support such as Ps and process naming, making it the central process-management layer above the lower-level SYSTEM coroutine backend.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the concrete implementation behind Executive.def: it defines the semaphore and descriptor records, ready/existing/semaphore queues, current and idle processes, and implements scheduling, queue manipulation, context switching, and initialization that the .def file only exposes as an interface.
